points.description: States that the collision domain diameter decreases by a factor of 10 (becomes one tenth of its original size), e.g. 300m to 30m. Equivalent wording such as 'shrinks tenfold' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying the diameter decreases by a factor of about 10. No mark for saying it increases, stays the same, or decreases without the factor of 10 given.
